meta.name: chart-visualization
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to visualize data. It intelligently selects the most suitable chart type from 26 available options, extracts parameters based on detailed specifications, and generates a chart image using a JavaScript script.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成直观的图表图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把数据做成图表
copy.tagline_en: Turn your data into clear chart images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn data into charts

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求把数据变成图表时,Claude会分析数据特征,从26种图表类型中挑选合适的一种,读取对应规格说明提取参数,运行JavaScript脚本生成图表,并把图片链接和完整参数返回给用户。
howto.when: 当用户提出想可视化数据、绘制图表等需求时触发,尤其在给出数据并要求生成图表的场景下接管。

say.text: 把这份Excel数据画成折线图
say.note: Claude会识别趋势数据并生成折线图

say.text: 对比各部门业绩,用柱状图展示
say.note: 触发柱状图生成并返回图片链接

say.text: 用饼图展示各产品线占比
say.note: 生成饼图,输出图片和参数说明

howto.what_en: After enabling, when the user asks to turn data into charts, Claude analyzes the data, picks one of 26 chart types, reads the spec to extract parameters, runs a JavaScript script to generate the chart, and returns the image URL plus full parameter set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to visualize data or asks for a chart, e.g., after providing data requesting a chart.

say_en.text: Turn this Excel data into a line chart.
say_en.note: Claude detects trend data and creates a line chart.

say_en.text: Compare department performance with a bar chart.
say_en.note: Triggers bar chart generation and returns the image link.

say_en.text: Show product line share as a pie chart.
say_en.note: Generates a pie chart and outputs image and parameters.
